question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}-5 \\ 5 \\ -10\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -1 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ -1 \\ 3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-5 \\ 5 \\ -10\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1} \\ -{x}_{1} \\ 2{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-5 \\ 5 \\ -10\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-5 \\ 5 \\ -10\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=-5 \\ -{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=5 \\ 2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=-10\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Adding the first and the second equations we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} &=0 \\ {x}_{2} &=0\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{2}=0$ into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=-5 \\ {x}_{1}-(0) &=-5 \\ {x}_{1} &=-5 \\ {x}_{1} &=-5\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-5$ and ${x}_{2}=0$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=-10 \\ 2(-5)+3(0) &=-10 \\ -10 &=-10\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-5$ and ${x}_{2}=0$, which means

$$
-5{a}_{1}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(-5)+(0)=-5.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}4 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ 16 \\ 6\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}4 \\ -2 \\ 3\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}-1 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ 16 \\ 6\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}4{x}_{1} \\ -2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ 16 \\ 6\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}4{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} \\ -2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}11 \\ 16 \\ 6\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=11 \\ -2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=16 \\ 3{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=6\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Multiplying the third equation by $-1$ and adding the result to the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} &=5\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{1}=5$ into the third equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=6 \\ 3(5)-{x}_{2} &=6 \\ -{x}_{2} &=-9 \\ {x}_{2} &=9\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=5$ and ${x}_{2}=9$ into the second equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=16 \\ -2(5)+3(9) &=16 \\ 17 &=16\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a false statement.

So, the system has no solution.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}-10 \\ 2 \\ -23\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}-4 \\ 2 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-10 \\ 2 \\ -23\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}-4{x}_{1} \\ 2{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}{x}_{2} \\ 0 \\ 4{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-10 \\ 2 \\ -23\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}-4{x}_{1}+{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-10 \\ 2 \\ -23\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-4{x}_{1}+{x}_{2} &=-10 \\ 2{x}_{1} &=2 \\ {x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=-23\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the second equation we get ${x}_{1}=1$.

Substituting ${x}_{1}=1$ into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-4{x}_{1}+{x}_{2} &=-10 \\ -4(1)+{x}_{2} &=-10 \\ {x}_{2} &=-6 \\ {x}_{2} &=-6\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=1$ and ${x}_{2}=-6$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=-23 \\ (1)+4(-6) &=-23 \\ -23 &=-23\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=1$ and ${x}_{2}=-6$, which means

$$
{a}_{1}-6{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(1)+(-6)=-5.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}5 \\ 7 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 4 \\ 3\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ 29 \\ - \frac{19}{2}\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}5 \\ 7 \\ -1\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 4 \\ 3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ 29 \\ - \frac{19}{2}\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}5{x}_{1} \\ 7{x}_{1} \\ -{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ 29 \\ - \frac{19}{2}\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}5{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} \\ 7{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}22 \\ 29 \\ - \frac{19}{2}\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}5{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} &=22 \\ 7{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=29 \\ -{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=- \frac{19}{2}\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Multiplying the first equation by $-2$ and adding the result to the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-3{x}_{1} &=-15 \\ {x}_{1} &=5\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{1}=5$ into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}5{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} &=22 \\ 5(5)+2{x}_{2} &=22 \\ 2{x}_{2} &=-3 \\ {x}_{2} &=- \frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=5$ and ${x}_{2}=- \frac{3}{2}$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}-{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=- \frac{19}{2} \\ -(5)+3\left(- \frac{3}{2}\right) &=- \frac{19}{2} \\ - \frac{19}{2} &=- \frac{19}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=5$ and ${x}_{2}=- \frac{3}{2}$, which means

$$
5{a}_{1}- \frac{3}{2}{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(5)+\left(- \frac{3}{2}\right)=\frac{7}{2}.
$$
